name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access to bombed sites; ~441 kg at 60%
summary: Iran says inspections of bombed nuclear sites cannot go ahead under current conditions; no strike on nuclear sites found
state: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman said on 9 Nov that Iran will not send its enriched uranium abroad and that inspections of nuclear sites damaged in US attacks cannot proceed under current conditions (Iran International). The ministry also said the IAEA had inspected Bushehr a few days earlier (CBS News). The IAEA last put Iran's stock at about 441 kg enriched to 60%. No strike on a nuclear site, NPT withdrawal or evidence of weaponisation was found as of 10 Nov.
for_you: This is a diplomatic and security issue with no direct public guidance. Travellers to the region should check FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Enrichment at 60% and inspector access to bombed sites curtailed; no strike or NPT exit
